text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor d-r-a-f-t-e-d the s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e in a s-e-c-r-e-t c-h-a-n-n-e-l and s-t-o-r-e-d the f-i-l-e d-7-7-1 as a n-e-g-o-t-i-a-t-e-d m-e-m-o while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-e-t-e-n-c-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) the actor m-o-d-e-l-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s with a t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e w-o-r-d-p-r-o-c-e-s-s f-i-l-e and p-o-s-t-e-d the v-e-r-s-i-o-n-s to a c-l-o-u-d f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a a-u-d-i-t.
3) the actor a-g-r-e-e-d the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n p-l-a-n over a v-i-d-e-o c-a-l-l and a-v-a-l-a-n-g-u-a-g-e n-o-t-e-s and r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d the a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t as a n-e-x-t s-t-e-p i-t-e-m while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e.
4) the actor s-e-t u-p the h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t v-i-a a s-h-e-l-l e-n-t-i-t-y w-i-r-e and l-a-b-e-l-e-d the t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n as a c-o-n-s-u-l-t-i-n-g f-e-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-t-i-l-a-u-n-d-w-a-s-h-i-n-g c-h-e-c-k.
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the f-i-l-e in the c-a-s-e m-a-n-a-g-e-m-e-n-t s-y-s-t-e-m and a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the e-x-h-i-b-i-t-s under a b-o-u-n-d a-r-e-a c-o-d-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-i-g-n-o-f-f.
